input: Create a professional email signature with my logo

gold.taskTitle: Create a professional email signature with logo
gold.taskDescription: Design and set up a professional email signature that includes the user's logo along with relevant contact and branding details.

questions.title: Which email platform will you use this signature in?
questions.description: Identify the email client or platform (e.g., Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail) where the signature will be installed.

questions.title: What name and job title should the signature display?
questions.description: Gather the full name and professional title to be shown in the signature.

questions.title: Which contact details do you want included?
questions.description: Determine which contact information to include, such as phone number, website, or physical address.

questions.title: Do you have the logo file ready, and in what format?
questions.description: Confirm whether the logo file exists and identify its format (e.g., PNG, SVG, JPEG) and approximate dimensions.

questions.title: What visual style or color scheme should it follow?
questions.description: Understand the preferred design direction, such as brand colors, font preferences, or a minimalist versus detailed look.

questions.title: Should any social media profile links be included?
questions.description: Find out if links to LinkedIn, Twitter, or other platforms need to appear in the signature.

questions.title: Is there a legal disclaimer or tagline to add at the bottom?
questions.description: Check whether a confidentiality notice, company tagline, or any other required text needs to be appended.
